rules.name: Track Requirements
rules.desc: To fulfill the Arabic Track, students must earn a minimum of 24 units total. The faculty director must approve all courses.

children.name: Required Coursework: Arabic Courses at 3rd, 4th, and 5th-Year Level
Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI)
children.desc: Students must take the Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) in Arabic two quarters prior to degree conferral, minimally earning a notation of "intermediate-high". Students should contact the Stanford Language Center to arrange the assessment.

rules.name: Track Requirements
rules.desc: To fulfill the Hebrew Track, students must earn a minimum of 32 units total. The faculty director must approve all courses.

children.name: Hebrew Language Courses
children.desc: Students must complete a minimum of three (3) Hebrew language classes. This requirement may be tested out of this requirement with the approval of the faculty director.

children.name: Hebrew Literature and Culture Courses
children.desc: Students must complete a minimum of 20 units of Hebrew literature and culture courses, one of which must be listed in COMPLIT. The Hebrew Forum may count towards this requirement with the approval of the faculty director

children.name: Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI)
children.desc: Students must take the Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) in Hebrew two quarters prior to degree conferral, minimally earning a notation of "intermediate-high". Students should contact the Stanford Language Center to arrange the assessment.

blocks.name: African Languages, Literatures and Cultures Track

rules.name: Track Requirements
rules.desc: To fulfill the African Languages, Literatures, and Cultures Track, students must earn a minimum 32 units total. The faculty director must approve all courses.

children.name: African Language Courses
children.desc: Students must complete a sequence of three (3) African language classes all toward the same language.

children.name: African Literature Courses
children.desc:
Students must complete 20 additional units from relevant literature and culture courses; one of these courses must be a COMPLIT course.
Students may enroll in other relevant courses listed under AFRICAST. The faculty director may approve some upper-level language classes to count toward the remaining units.

children.name: Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI)
children.desc: Students must take the Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) in an African Language two quarters prior to degree conferral, minimally earning a notation of "intermediate-high". Students should contact the Stanford Language Center to arrange the assessment.

rules.name: Track Requirements
rules.desc: To fulfill the Persian Track, students must earn a minimum 30 units total. The faculty director must approve all courses.

children.name: Persian Language Courses
children.desc: Students must complete 20 units of Persian language courses.

children.name: Persian Literature Courses in Comparative Literature
children.desc: Students must complete 10 units of Persian-focused courses in COMPLIT.

children.name: Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI)
children.desc: Students must take the Oral Proficiency Interview (OPI) in Persian two quarters prior to degree conferral, minimally earning a notation of "intermediate-high". Students should contact the Stanford Language Center to arrange the assessment.

children.name: Turkish Literature Courses in Comparative Literature
children.desc: Students must complete 15 units of Turkish-focused courses in COMPLIT.
